name: Humble Beginnings
summary: Baros Alexston seeks help from his home in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. His family's Westfall farm has burned, and thieves hold its ruins; he hopes to recover an heirloom from his youth.

sections.title: A Builder's Roots
sections.body: Baros Alexston grew up working the fields of Westfall. Now he is an accomplished architect in Stormwind City, advising on stonework and city buildings. His path from farm boy to city planner is rare in the kingdom, yet he remains attached to the modest beginnings that shaped him.

sections.title: Tragedy in Westfall
sections.body: Lawlessness swept across Westfall, and the Alexston Farmstead fell to it. Bandits and vagrants burned the house, forcing Baros's father from his livelihood. Family heirlooms were left behind amid the fire and occupation. Baros asks you to search the ruined, bandit-held farmstead west of Sentinel Hill for his first compass, hidden before the home fell.

faq.answer: Baros Alexston is Stormwind's City Architect, residing near Cathedral Square. He grew up as a farmer's son in Westfall, then left the countryside to learn the craft of building.

faq.q: Where is the Alexston Farmstead located?
faq.answer: The Alexston Farmstead lies west of Sentinel Hill in central Westfall. Thieves and rogues aligned with the Defias rabble burned it and took control of the property.

faq.q: Why is the compass important to Baros?
faq.answer: The compass matters to Baros only for its sentimental value. It was his first navigation tool as a boy on the farm, a reminder of his path from rural laborer to architectural planner. It has no use in his current craft, but remains an irreplaceable relic of his past.

faq.q: Who burned down the Alexston farm?
faq.answer: Thieves and outlaws terrorizing Westfall razed the farm. With the kingdom's military spread thin and unable to protect outlying homesteads, bandits seized the land and drove out the Alexston family.

faq.q: Where can the compass be found on the farm?
faq.answer: Baros's compass was hidden before the family fled. You can find it in a small chest amid the charred ruins of the main farmhouse.
Baros's father survived the raid and fled the farm. He could not carry their possessions through the flames and bandits, but remembered where the family had hidden valuable keepsakes.

angles.text: The Alexston Farmstead's fate reflects the decline of Westfall's yeomanry, where generations of human farmers have been driven from their land by lawlessness on Stormwind's doorstep.
When you venture into Westfall on behalf of figures in the capital, you cross the divide between Stormwind's safe streets and the nearby frontier lands left unprotected.
